56:2: There is no denier for its occurrence.
56:4: When the earth is shaken with a severe shaking
56:5: And the mountains are crumbled to pieces.
56:8: So the men of the right, what are the men of the right!
56:9: And the companions of the left side, what are the companions of the left side!
56:11: Those are the ones brought near.
56:13: A company from the first ones.
56:14: And a small group from the later ones.
56:16: They recline upon them face to face.
56:18: With cups, pitchers, and goblets filled from a spring.
56:19: Their heads do not ache from it, nor do they become intoxicated.
56:20: And there are fruits of whatever they choose.
56:21: And whatever bird meat they desire
56:22: And there are houris with wide eyes.
56:24: As a reward for what they used to do.
56:25: They hear neither idle talk therein nor anything leading to sin.
56:27: As for those on the right, how fortunate are those on the right!
56:35: Indeed, We have created them with a creation.
56:37: Devoted to their spouses, of equal age.
56:38: We made them spouses for the people of the right side.
56:39: A multitude from the former ones.
56:40: And a multitude from the later ones.
56:41: And the companions of the left side, what are the companions of the left side!
56:42: In scorching heat and boiling water
56:43: And they are in the shade of pitch-black smoke.
56:45: Indeed, before this they were affluent.
56:46: And they used to persist in the great sin.
56:47: They used to say: When we die and become dust and bones, will we indeed be resurrected?
56:49: Say: Indeed, the former ones and the later ones.
56:50: Indeed, the former ones and the later ones will surely be gathered for the appointed time of a known day.
56:51: Then indeed, you, O astray ones, deniers!
56:52: They will surely eat from the tree of Zaqqum.
56:53: Then you will be fillers of bellies from it.
56:54: Upon it you will be drinkers of boiling water.
56:55: You will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
56:56: This is their hospitality on the Day of Judgment.
56:57: We created you, so will you not confirm?
56:58: Have you seen the semen that you emit?
56:59: Do you create it, or are We the Creators?
56:60: We decreed death among you, and We are not outdone.
56:61: It is to replace your likenesses and to recreate you in what you do not know.
56:62: And certainly you knew the first creation, so will you not reflect?
56:63: Do you see that which you sow?
56:64: Do you make it grow, or are We the ones who make it grow?
56:65: If We willed, We could have surely made it debris, and you would remain astounded.
56:66: Indeed, we are laden with debt.
56:68: Have you seen the water that you drink
56:69: Did you bring it down from the cloud, or are We the ones who send it down?
56:70: If We willed, We could have made it bitter, so will you not give thanks?
56:71: Have you seen that fire which you kindle?
56:72: Did you create its tree, or are We the Creators?
56:73: We made it a reminder and a means of benefit for those who are strong.
56:74: So glorify the great name of your Rabb.
56:75: Nay, I swear by the settings of the stars.
56:76: Indeed, it is a great oath, if you knew.
56:77: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an.
56:79: None touches it except the purified.
56:80: It has been sent down from the Rabb of the worlds.
56:81: Is it then this discourse that you treat with indifference?
56:82: Have you made your denial your provision?
56:83: Then why, when the soul reaches the throat,
56:84: While you were at that time looking on.
56:85: We are nearer to him than you are, but you do not see.
56:86: Then if you were not to be called to account,
56:87: Will you bring it back, if you are truthful?
56:88: Then if he is of those brought near,
56:89: Then for him is rest, good provision, and a garden of bliss.
56:90: And if he is of the companions of the right,
56:91: They say: Peace be upon you from those on the right.
56:92: And if he is of the deniers, the astray,
56:93: Then for him is a feast of boiling water.
56:95: Indeed, this is the absolute truth.
56:96: So glorify the name of your great Rabb.
